summary: Request for extended GPU-laptop loan and expanded service-account scope during cross-team onboarding ramp
description:
Issue summary: New hire joining devinfra on 2026-03-15 requires an extended loaner of the team's GPU-enabled developer laptop for 8 weeks (policy max 4 weeks) and temporary elevated service-account scopes to run dataset migration jobs for ramp tasks.

Background: Candidate accepted role as Staff ML Engineer. Hiring manager (Sara Gomez) says ramp tasks require local CUDA drivers, 48GB GPU memory, and access to dedicated staging S3 buckets and a dataset-migration service account that normally is restricted to infra leads. Standard onboarding process issues a loaner for 4 weeks and provides scoped service accounts after training completion.

Request: Approve exception to extend loaner to 8 weeks and provision temporary service-account scope (datasets:read,datasets:write,staging:s3-access) for the account infra-ramp@redwood.example.com until 2026-05-10. Also request expedited license transfer for MATLAB (team-use) and a check that KMS keys used for staging are allowed by policy for contractor-level keys.

Impact: If declined or delayed, new hire ramp will be blocked from completing core onboarding tasks, delaying project timeline by ~2-3 sprints. Risk of policy noncompliance if service-account scopes granted without attestation or signed exception.

Requested timeline: Decision and provisioning by 2026-03-14 to ship laptop and enable access before start date.

Attachments: offer letter snippet (attached in ticket), manager approval email (quoted below).
manager_approval: Manager approval received via email from Sara Gomez on 2026-03-09: 'We need this exception for onboarding. I will run daily pair sessions and own attestation.'
steps_to_reproduce: N/A — policy exception request rather than a reproducible bug. Operational steps desired by manager: (1) approve exception, (2) create exception ticket in compliance tracker, (3) provision loaner and ship, (4) create scoped service-account with TTL=8w, (5) record attestation and handover notes.

resolution_notes: Pending — awaiting Security attestation form and PR #3421 merge. Shipping hold until compliance record created.
